top_findings.title: One of four tests fails: hardcoded /books/1 breaks because DELETE does not reset AUTOINCREMENT
top_findings.evidence: test_coverage=0.75 in scores.json (scorer = Surefire pass rate = 3/4). src/test/java/com/example/books/BookApiTest.java:22 clearDatabase() runs `DELETE FROM books` in @BeforeEach, which does NOT reset the SQLite AUTOINCREMENT id sequence in the shared in-memory DB (@SpringBootTest, cache=shared). The two id-dependent tests assume id==1: createsListsFiltersAndReadsBook (line 29, get /books/1) and updatesAndDeletesBook (lines 33-36, insert then put/delete /books/1). Whichever runs second sees id>=2, so its /books/1 calls 404 and the test fails.
top_findings.suggestion: Do not hardcode id 1. Either reset the sequence per-test (DELETE FROM sqlite_sequence WHERE name='books', or DROP/recreate the table in @BeforeEach), or capture the id returned by POST/INSERT and use it in subsequent requests.
